summary: A page: head with Vanilla Breeze, skip link, site header, main with the page heading, and an optional footer.
use: The root of every page plan. The title reads "Title | Site"; navigation goes in nav, the content in main, and site/footer in footer.

title.description: The page's own title, ahead of the site name.

site.description: The site name: the home link in the header and the end of the title.

nav.description: The site navigation, in the header ahead of the h1.

main.description: The page's content, below its h1.

obligations: The heading says what the page is about, and the description summarizes it.
